context: M6 o5. 8th Ave & W 38th St. Brannock's car at the curb, Lonnie leaning on it.

lines.speaker: char.lonnie_gage
lines.text: Del, baby. Sunday best. Jimmy wants a word about the new rates.

lines.speaker: char.jimmy_brannock
lines.text: Tax is due, sweetheart. City's broke, didn't you hear?

lines.speaker: char.jimmy_brannock
lines.text: Fifty a week, each girl. Not twenty-five. Inflation. Read the papers.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Here. Count it. I know you can count to fifty.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Here. Your badge says Brannock and your ring says married. I read both, honey.

lines.speaker: char.jimmy_brannock
lines.text: Smile for the camera? Lady, I am the camera.

lines.speaker: char.lonnie_gage
lines.text: Everybody on this avenue works for somebody. You just don't know who.
